label: PF Backlog 537
title: C5: AI Security Control Plane - Risk engine + Policy engine (+ policy versioning)
body:
## Problem / why
Signals (regex/semantic/PII) and scattered policies are not a unified risk+policy decision.
## Acceptance criteria
A Risk engine scores user+content+tool+data+agent+environment+action+tenant+destination; a Policy engine (deterministic-first) decides ALLOW|ALLOW_WITH_RESTRICTIONS|REVIEW|SANDBOX|QUARANTINE|BLOCK|ABORT; policies are versioned, reviewed, tested, reversible; risk != authorization.
## Out of scope
Semantic detector (P1).
